risk_note: RV2 (ledger). Reversal command reverse(trx, { appId, originalUniqKey }) per BR-FUND-16 / BR-FUND-10 / BR-FUND-15 (decision 32): writes one whole-voucher reversal with uniq_key = original || ':REVERSE', keeping voucher_kind, order_key, beneficiary and role; every entry negated with the same account, sub_account, ledger_type and sub_type (subFen on bigint, no rounding). It reuses the posting core (lock registry, sorted balance row locks with version compare, mayGoNegative, SAVEPOINT replay); an ordinary reversal gets no REASSIGN_REV negative-balance exemption. Idempotency ends at the (app_id, uniq_key) unique constraint; replay returns the existing voucher; a voucher can be reversed once. Accounting date from the injected Clock via @couli/domain. The invariant side (replacement 03) lands first in B2-02l.
